verdict.rationale: Docs show concrete spend-cap mechanics (mandate declineThreshold, effectiveUntilTime) and a documented ability to 'cancel a purchase intent,' plus lifecycle management of agent-specific tokens, which together approximate spend caps and revocation. However the evidence centers on canceling a single purchase-intent, not a clear instant global revoke of an agent's entire payment authority, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of revocation speed or scope. Missing for 10: explicit 'revoke agent' API/documentation, broader usage-limit controls beyond per-purchase decline thresholds, and third-party verification of instant revocation.
